title: Vanderbilt RB Sedrick Alexander to donate $280 per touchdown in honor of former Titans star Chris Johnson

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Vanderbilt RB Sedrick Alexander to donate $280 per touchdown in honor of former Titans star Chris Johnson
sources.description: Vanderbilt running back Sedrick Alexander will donate $280 per touchdown scored moving forward, to the ALS Association, in honor of former Tennessee Titans RB Chris Johnson.
